run_parallel_evolution: run a process-based parallel evolution loop with multiple worker processes across islands
submit_evolution_iteration: submit a single evolution iteration to the process pool pinned to a specific island
create_database_snapshot: create a serializable snapshot of the program database state for worker processes
initialize_worker_process: initialize a worker process with config, LLM ensemble, prompt sampler, and evaluator
review_serializable_result: review the SerializableResult dataclass used to pickle evolution results between processes
